problem:
Consider the solid enclosed between the paraboloid $x=-2+{y}^{2}+4{z}^{2}$ and the parabolic cylinder $x=-1+2{z}^{2},$ whose volume can be written in terms of double integrals, as follows:

$$
V={\int }_{-1}^{1}{\int }_{a(y)}^{b(y)}\,f(y,z)\,dz\,dy
$$

What is ${a}^{2}+{b}^{2}+f?$
